description: Lock-step manifest for the pinned detector sources. Every row is an upstream this package DERIVES its tables from, except trufflehog, which is a tests-only conformance oracle. A pin bump means re-running `pnpm run gen` and re-reviewing the NOTICE attribution.

rows.notes: Agent-config rule source (MIT). Supplies all 131 rows in data/agent-configs.json plus the SKILL.md governance rules.
Plugin-capability source (Apache-2.0, attributed in NOTICE). Contributes the 9 capability rows in data/skills.json; it has no regex corpus to derive.
Primary secret-detector source (MIT). 221 of the 317 rows in data/secrets.json derive from its generated TOML config.
Primary agent-skill pattern source (Apache-2.0, attributed in NOTICE). 416 of the 427 rows in data/skills.json derive from its static analyzer modules.
Second secret-detector source (Apache-2.0, attributed in NOTICE). Supplies severity, which gitleaks does not express, plus the manifest-scoped Maven rules.

CONFORMANCE-ONLY coverage oracle. AGPL-3.0, so it is TESTS-ONLY: no generator reads it and no row cites it. A pin bump must keep the sparse-checkout tests-only — see docs/agents.md/repo/upstream-slices.md.
Workflow-audit source (MIT). The port is documentation-driven; a new upstream audit fails the generator until it is triaged in .config/repo/zizmor-audit-status.json.
